messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: SEV2 — policy-engine runtime panic observed while evaluating routing rules. Errors starting at 2026-03-15T02:14Z. Affected region: eu-west-1 with spillover into us-east-1. Symptoms: elevated 5xx from routing layer, repeated fallback to incompatible model variants causing inference errors.
Aisha D.: Acked. I'm oncall. Saw alerts in Sentry and traces showing policy_eval::panic. Starting investigation.
Matt J.: I'm seeing a tight loop in routing telemetry — requests keep bouncing between eu-west-1 and us-east-1 because fallback policy is triggering then re-evaluating the same rule.
Devon K.: Logs from policy-engine:```
panic: runtime error: index out of range
goroutine 42 [running]:
github.com/redwood/inference/policy/eval.(*Expr).Eval(...)
  /src/policy/eval/expr.go:132
main.handleRequest(0xc0001ae000)
  /src/policy/main.go:214
```
Devon K.: stack points at custom expression 'region_variant_selector' which was changed in yesterday's rollout.
Aisha D.: Can we isolate by forcing policy-engine to serve a safe default? Options: 1) disable evaluation of custom exprs via toggle; 2) route all traffic to static default model per region; 3) scale down policy-engine to kill lively cache?
Kevin L.: Quick mitigation — recommend flipping routing fallback to static fallback model (pin to redwood/base-1.3) and disable the new expression evaluation module. I can push config change.
Sara (support): Heads up — three customers reported errors: acme-corp build pipeline, fintech-ops realtime scoring, and studytools integration. All show inference errors (400/422) after routing picks variant mismatch.
Aisha D.: Kevin, do the config change and report back. I'll open a mitigation ticket and notify affected customers with temporary workaround (pin model in their routes).
Kevin L.: Rolling config now. Command: ``deployctl set-config policy.routing.fallback_mode static && deployctl set-config policy.eval.custom_expressions.enabled false``
deploy-bot: Started rollout (cfg-change-1930001). Target: policy-plane. Canarying to 10% nodes.
observability-bot: Alert: 5xx rate in eu-west-1 dropped from 6.2% -> 2.1% within 90s of canary. Routing loop count decreased by 80%.
Matt J.: Confirming fallbacks are now stable on canary nodes. Still see a handful of requests failing because cached routing decisions keep re-propagating. Cache TTL is 30s.
Devon K.: I can push a cache invalidation: ``curl -XPOST https://policy-cache.internal/flush -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`` — will clear in all regions.
Aisha D.: Do it. Also collect a heap and goroutine dump from one of the crashed policy-engine pods for postmortem.
Devon K.: Cache flush done. Running ``kubectl exec -it policy-engine-xyz -- pprof heap > /tmp/heap.dump`` and ``goroutine profile``. Uploading to /tmp/incident-artifacts.
Kevin L.: Rollout completed: cfg-change-1930001 -> success. All nodes now on static fallback, custom expressions disabled.
Sara (support): Customer impact update: acme-corp's API error rate back to normal after they pinned model. Fintech-ops still seeing delayed responses during cache TTL window but no 5xx. I've sent interim message to all affected customers: "We're mitigating by pinning fallbacks and disabling new rule evaluations; a full postmortem will follow."
Aisha D.: Good. Next: revert or patch? The root cause is an index out of range in expr.go when evaluating geo-based variant arrays for certain inbound requests with empty metadata. Two paths: revert yesterday's rollout that added geo_variant_selector OR patch expr.go to check bounds and nils. Which is faster?
Matt J.: Revert is fastest but global rollback might affect unrelated fixes. Patch small guard and roll forward is preferable if we can get it reviewed fast.
Irina P.: I can take the patch. I'll add nil/len checks and unit tests for empty metadata cases. ETA ~45m to PR, 15m to canary, 30m to full rollout if tests pass.
Aisha D.: Sounds good. Irina, please coordinate with deploy for canary windows. Kevin, keep monitoring routing metrics and TTL churn. Devon, keep capturing logs for the postmortem. Sara, keep customers updated.
Irina P.: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/policy/merge_requests/814. Patch adds bounds checks and a fallback branch that returns static variant when metadata missing. CI passing on unit tests.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for MR 814 on policy-engine: 3 pods in eu-west-1.
observability-bot: Canary: routing loop metric dropped to baseline, error rate in canary nodes at 0.4%.
Matt J.: Canary looks clean. Approving ramp.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% completed. Deployment id: canary-814-20260315.
Aisha D.: Patch in prod. I'm going to run quick evals against synthetic traffic and a couple of customer routes.
Devon K.: Heap/goroutine dumps uploaded: /tmp/incident-artifacts/1930001234/ — included the panic trace and input payloads that triggered the index access.
Sara (support): Notifying customers with final mitigation note: "We deployed a fix and disabled the experimental expression module. We recommend you remove any reliance on geo_variant_selector until we ship a hardened version. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."
Aisha D.: Incident status: mitigation complete, customer-facing workaround applied, patch deployed. Impact window ~02:14Z–02:40Z (~26m). Postmortem: assign to policy-team (Irina, Devon), oncall (Aisha), and SRE (Matt) to produce runbook updates and a hardened test for expression edge-cases.
Irina P.: I'll own the postmortem and a follow-up PR to re-enable expressions behind stricter validation and a feature flag.
Aisha D.: Handoff to next-day oncall: @Irina P. — I'm off in 25m; leaving summary and artifacts in the ticket. If anything regresses, page @oncall.
Irina P.: Received. Summary noted. I'll monitor the 6h retention window and validate customer routes tomorrow morning.
Sara (support): Closing customer interim notices. Will follow up with targeted messages once postmortem is ready.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated) — all alerts suppressed. Incident ticket: INC-1930001234.
Aisha D.: Thanks everyone. Postmortem draft requested by EOD tomorrow.
Matt J.: Adding action items to runbook: - validate expression evaluation inputs - add unit tests for empty metadata - alert when fallback loop > 5/min
Devon K.: I'll include a small fuzz test harness for expressions.
Irina P.: Will reopen expressions behind stricter flag and add runtime guardrails.
Sara (support): Logged impacted customers and messages in INC-1930001234 notes.
Aisha D.: Closing thread for now, will re-open if new signals appear.
